reviewed: false friends and a malformed headword, entries 950-1860 (ratings 4-5)
_finding: The defects left in this file are almost all English-side: an Italian word glossed with its English lookalike rather than its meaning. attitudine is the clearest --- it means aptitude, and the entry sat directly beside atteggiamento 'attitude', so the matching game offered two entries with the same answer and only one was right.

rows._was: en was 'attitude', which is atteggiamento --- already in the file, correctly glossed, and adjacent to this entry in rating order.
en was 'argument' with topic and subject demoted. An argomento is what something is about; a quarrel is a discussione or a litigio.
en was 'to sort' with 'to order' demoted. Ordering food or giving an order is the everyday sense, and the file already leans on it in 'sono pronto per ordinare'.
en was 'according to me', which is not idiomatic English.
the headword was the conjugated 'affrancate' rather than an infinitive, unlike every other verb entry, and 'to frank' alone is opaque to most learners.
